Coaching Services

Premium Coaching

The most comprehensive coaching option for serious athletes seeking personalized attention and advanced programming.

Premium Coaching is designed for athletes who demand the highest level of support. This comprehensive program provides personalized periodized programming, weekly video check-ins, hands-on technique feedback, and real-time program adjustments to ensure you're always training at peak efficiency.

Whether you're preparing for competition, working through an injury, or simply looking to optimize your training, Premium Coaching delivers the attention and expertise you need to reach your full potential.

Pricing

$1,200 per 8-week program

Invest in the highest level of coaching support available.

What's Included in Premium Coaching

When you choose Premium Coaching, you get access to all the core features plus enhanced support designed for ambitious athletes.

🎯 Personalized Periodized Programming

Custom-designed 8-12 week programs built around your goals, sport, and current fitness level. Programs include clear progression schemes, exercise selection, and recovery periods tailored to your specific needs.

📹 Weekly Video Check-ins

Regular 15-minute video calls to discuss your training, review progress, and address any questions or concerns. These check-ins ensure you're on track and allow us to make timely adjustments.

🤲 Technique Feedback (Remote & In-Person Options)

Receive video analysis of your technique with specific feedback on form, alignment, and efficiency. Available via remote video review or in-person sessions at your location.

⚡ Real-Time Program Adjustments

Programs are living documents that evolve with your progress. We'll review and adjust programming based on your performance, recovery, and changing goals throughout the cycle.

🍎 Nutrition & Recovery Guidance

Strategic recommendations for fueling your training and optimizing recovery. We'll help you understand how nutrition impacts your performance and provide simple, actionable adjustments.

📈 Progress Tracking Reviews

Regular reviews of your training log, PRs, and performance metrics. We'll identify trends, celebrate wins, and use data to inform future programming decisions.

🔍 Personalized Attention
